staticFrame.alt: An illustrated coastal causeway at sunrise. A small companion figure walks a dotted route carrying evidence slips, while the owner's mark waits by the writing room.

scenes.label: 01 / SecondSelf
scenes.heading:
What if the search
had a second you?
scenes.lead: A companion for the work of finding your next chapter.
scenes.narration: I built SecondSelf with an ambition: search for jobs and prepare applications the way I would. The journey starts with what I have actually done.

scenes.label: 02 / A place to begin
scenes.heading:
Start with
what is true.
scenes.lead: Experience is evidence, not raw material for invention.
scenes.narration: SecondSelf retrieves verified project, skill and experience records. The companion and landscape are fictional; no private knowledge entries or personal applications appear here.

scenes.label: 03 / Two ways to find it
scenes.heading:
Two paths.
One search.
scenes.lead: Exact terms and related experience both matter.
scenes.narration: Hybrid search combines lexical and semantic candidates. Gentle reranking changes their order without turning a weak match into a new fact.

scenes.label: 04 / Before the draft
scenes.heading:
Plausible is
not enough.
scenes.narration: The evidence check comes before drafting. Inspect these illustrative categories to see what can enter the packet and what cannot.

scenes.label: 05 / The prepared work
scenes.heading:
Bring something
worth reading.
scenes.lead: Evidence becomes a reviewable application packet.
scenes.narration: The draft keeps its provenance. Preparation is a stored process with an artifact to inspect, rather than a hidden browser step.

scenes.label: 06 / Durable human review
scenes.heading:
The way home
is part of the work.
scenes.lead: The pause belongs to the system.
scenes.narration: The completed packet enters the human review queue. Waiting is durable state, so it can survive a restart or a long delay. The system does not send silently.

scenes.label: 07 / The decision is yours
scenes.heading:
This part
needs you.
scenes.lead: Try a decision in this local illustration.
scenes.narration: You can approve, return for revision, or reject the prepared work. These controls rehearse the review boundary; they never send an application or message.

scenes.label: 08 / Assistance with a boundary
scenes.heading:
Help that leaves
you in charge.
scenes.lead: Preparation can be automated. Representation needs authority.
scenes.narration: SecondSelf recorded 0.9753 faithfulness on a 20-question internal RAGAS evaluation on 14 May 2026. That measures the retrieval-answer path, not job outcomes.

audio.explanation: This world is a silent illustrated journey. It has no audio asset and makes no audio request.

sourceAudit.label: SecondSelf committed safe evaluation and preparation fixtures
